name: Gelato OS-World agent trajectories
notes: The dataset card holds only license metadata; the description and scope come from the official Gelato README, which says this repository provides all of the agent's OS-World trajectories from runs on a fixed OS-World snapshot with GPT-5 as planner and a 50-step limit. The file list also holds the GTA1-32B baseline runs from the same harness, which the README compares but does not name as part of this release. The README reports 58.71 ± 0.66% automated and 61.85 ± 0.79% human-corrected success for Gelato-30B-A3B, against 56.97 ± 1.47% and 59.47 ± 1.27% for GTA1-32B; these were not reproduced. The GitHub repository has no license file; MIT is the dataset card's declaration. Files were not downloaded.
summary: Gelato-30B-A3B and GTA1-32B OS-World agent runs, three trials each in the same GPT-5-planned GTA1.5-based harness, with per-task trajectories, initial and step screenshots, and automated results.
